title: SvgLinearGradient
responsibility: Renders the native linearGradient element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgLinearGradient.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte snippet rendered inside the native linearGradient element when provided; if omitted or falsy, no child snippet is rendered. The component does not validate the snippet content.

outputs.name: SvgLinearGradient
outputs.description: A native SVG linearGradient element with all props except children forwarded as attributes and the optional snippet rendered inside. The component adds no wrapper around the element.
